goal: Review concurrent code for races, shared state, deadlocks and unbounded parallel work.
use: Review concurrent code for races, shared state, deadlocks and unbounded parallel work. Use when code uses threads, tasks, goroutines, async work or locks.

steps.note: Find the concurrency. List each thread, task, background job or parallel loop, and what each one shares.
Check shared state. Flag shared mutable data read or written without a lock or a single owner.
Check ordering of locks. Flag code that takes two locks in different orders, which can deadlock.
Check bounds. Parallel work needs a limit.
Check cancellation. Long-running work must stop when its caller stops.
Report. List each finding as file and line, with severity, the problem and the fix.

protocol.title: Find the concurrency
protocol.text: List each thread, task, background job or parallel loop, and what each one shares.

protocol.title: Check shared state
protocol.text: Flag shared mutable data read or written without a lock or a single owner.

protocol.title: Check ordering of locks
protocol.text: Flag code that takes two locks in different orders, which can deadlock.

protocol.title: Check bounds
protocol.text: Parallel work needs a limit. Flag loops that start one task per item with no cap.

protocol.title: Check cancellation
protocol.text: Long-running work must stop when its caller stops. Flag work that ignores cancellation.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List each finding as file and line, with severity, the problem and the fix. Mark what you could not reproduce.
